player.railTitle: Create, teach, and learn on one platform.
player.railBody: Content flows into courses and classrooms. Student questions, answers, and lab results flow back to help teachers keep improving the course.

hero.eyebrow: Developed by the CoAI Lab at Tsinghua University
hero.headline: <line>From one question to a</line><line>whole <accent>universe of knowledge</accent>.</line>
hero.body:
Videos, notes, and experiments are generated around the same question.

Content, courses, and learning records stay connected on one platform.
hero.interactionLabel: Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate the galaxy

journey.title: From question to verification in four steps.

steps.title: Ask the question that is holding you back
steps.body:
A concept from class, an assignment,

or a real problem at work.

steps.title: Generate video, notes, and experiments together
steps.body:
All three are generated around the same question.

Start with any format.

steps.title: Ask as you watch. Change things as you work.
steps.body: Pause the explanation, ask about details, run the code, or adjust a parameter and try again.

steps.title: Conclusions you can review. Sources you can trace.
steps.body: Return to experiment records and original sources, verify where the result came from, and confirm it can be reproduced.

video.title: Interactive video
video.body: Pause and ask at any moment. Switch explanations or adjust the level of detail without leaving the player.

frame.caption: Pause the frame and ask about it directly

aside.title: After a question, continue from the same place
aside.body: After the answer, playback resumes where you left off without losing context.

metric.label: into the same idea
metric.note: Build intuition with video, find the structure in notes, then test it in a lab.

notes.title: Interactive notes
notes.body: The outline, explanations, experiments, and sources grow from the same conversation and keep updating with every follow-up.

frame.path: SVD: from geometric intuition to AI practice
frame.caption: Every page links to the original conversation

metric.label: Notes that keep growing with the question
items: Build a full outline from a question

closing.title: Keep asking after the notes are generated.
closing.body:
Key ideas, relationships, experiments, and sources stay in one set of notes.

Continue learning from any page.

lab.title: Code lab
lab.body: Learners, teachers, and agents share one notebook, with every run, revision, and discussion on the record.

frame.caption: Run, observe, revise, and verify again

closing.title: Runnable. Reproducible.
closing.body:
Agents offer guidance at key steps while learners do the work and make the decisions.

Everyone shares the same code, output, and discussion.

interactiveLab.title: Interactive lab
interactiveLab.body: Describe what you want to test and generate a bench you can wire, tune, and try again. It works across digital circuits, mechanics, algorithms, and more, with no coding required.

frame.caption: Add logic gates and see each connection take effect

items: Describe the phenomenon you want to test
Generate the bench and required components
Wire components, adjust inputs, and observe the results

closing.title: Take it apart, change it, and see the result instantly.
closing.body:
Connections and parameter changes produce immediate feedback.

When something is wired incorrectly, the result points directly to the cause.

classroom.title: Cloud Classroom
classroom.body: Let the classroom grow into a textbook. Bring lesson planning, teaching, practice, and learning data together in one course.

frame.caption: Edit by hand or work with AI

closing.title: Keep your time for the decisions that need a teacher.
closing.body:
AI turns course materials into a chapter structure with 1-2 complete, long-form lessons per chapter. Videos and labs are embedded in each lesson, and end-of-chapter quizzes can be retaken. Teachers decide what stays and what changes.

Student answers, questions, and lab results flow back into the course to inform what you teach next.

nodes.title: Teach & learn
nodes.caption: Interact in class and work together

outcomes.title: One platform for every teaching and learning scenario.
outcomes.body: Learners, educators, and teams can start with the task at hand.

cards.title: Learn one question deeply, at your own pace
cards.body:
Start with a question: watch an explanation, run an experiment,

check the source, and go deeper step by step.
cards.tags: Interactive video · Interactive notes · Personal labs

cards.title: Keep improving the course, from lesson planning to after class
cards.body:
Create and revise course content, run lessons and assignments,

and use student learning records to improve what comes next.
cards.tags: Course building · Interactive teaching · Learning analytics
cards.footer: FROM SOURCE MATERIAL TO A COURSE

cards.title: Complete projects together, with the process and results preserved
cards.body:
Divide the work, discuss, and experiment around one task.

Materials, run results, and outcomes are shared across the team.
cards.footer: KEEP THE PROCESS AND THE RESULT

finale.title:
Your next question

starts here.
finale.body:
Start with a question, a set of materials, or a course:

create content, build a course, or learn independently.
